newsitem.title: USA: Hirel unit gets $3.0 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Hirel unit gets $3.0 mln order.

text.p: Hirel Holdings Inc said Thursday its Marine Power division has received a $3.0 million order from Tige Ski Boats, an Abilene, Texas,-based maker of precision watersport towboats.
The order is for Marine Power engines equipped with Hirel's patented, multi-port fuel injected intake manifold, Hirel said.
Delivery of the engines is scheduled to begin after Tige completes a two-month testing process, Hirel said.
Tige sells its watersport towboats to the tournament ski boat and family recreation markets.
Marine Power, based in Ponchatoula, La., was acquired by Hirel through its Hirel Technologies Inc subsidiary earlier this year.
